About Currency Converter

What this tool does

Our Currency Converter helps you convert amounts instantly between major world currencies. It uses a straightforward base-rate approach for quick client-side conversions and can be extended to fetch live market rates.

  • Fast, responsive conversions for travel, shopping, and finance.
  • Type or pick currencies using the smart suggestions list.
  • Light and dark themes for comfortable viewing.

Built for clarity — if you want live rates from providers like ExchangeRate-API or OpenExchangeRates, I can wire that in next.
